path_rule: All runtime resources are resolved from the software package root. Modules 01 and 02 share the same forward-request-v1 business input contract. Module 02 converts that complete request to frozen surrogate-model features and rejects unsupported variations.

notes.default_scene_template: 已废止旧模板补全机制。clean_case_template.dat 只负责序列化，不提供业务默认值。
notes.point_image_scene_template: The frozen model scene template is also the software default scene.
notes.source_case_id: Retained only as target/result provenance metadata. It no longer selects a per-case input.dat template.
notes.user_parameter_contract: 旧三参数开放合同已废止。01统一入口采用完整 forward-request-v1 六分区参数合同。
notes.clean_package: Only current runtime dependencies, standardized inputs, model resources, interface docs and minimal examples are retained. Legacy Optuna/Top-K/screening scripts, duplicate target curves and historical batch outputs are removed.
notes.forward_interface: 01统一入口要求完整 CASE/ENVIRONMENT/GROUP_STATE/OBSERVATION/TARGET_PHYSICS/TARGET_SCENE 请求；缺失、未知或额外字段均拒绝。
notes.forward_output: 01 formal runtime outputs are written only under 01-正向仿真/03-输出文件/runs/run_xxx/output. Core files include temperature_history.csv, infrared_response_history.csv (including radiant_intensity_W_sr), trajectory_history.csv, frame_summary.csv, solver_status.txt and run_metadata.json.
notes.rho_ir_policy: rho_ir 现为 TARGET_PHYSICS 中的显式业务输入，不再由统一入口根据 eps_ir 自动推导。
notes.surrogate_input: 02 no longer defines a three-parameter user request. The formal user input is the same complete forward-request-v1 JSON used by module 01; surrogate_standard_input.py performs model-applicability checks and feature extraction.
notes.surrogate_applicability: The software default scene and frozen model reference scene are identical; global q_int/eps_ir/alpha_s remain the supported learned variations.

forward_module_document: 01-正向仿真/00-正向仿真模块统一说明.docx
